# self-host

> One Go binary that installs, signs in, wires together and repairs self-hosted Apps with Docker Compose, for people through a terminal Dashboard and for agents through plain commands with --json.

Install on Linux, macOS or WSL with Docker and the Compose v2 plugin:

    curl -fsSL https://self-host.fyi/install | bash

Agents: run `self-host skill` and follow the guide it prints. Every change follows inspect, plan, approval, apply, verify; loading the skill is intent, never approval. Ask the person before any install, remove or restore, then pass --yes.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ajnart/selfhost-skills/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, Links, commands, Access, Backup
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/ajnart/selfhost-skills/blob/main/skills/self-host/SKILL.md): the discoverable skill, a router to `self-host skill`
- [Catalog JSON](https://self-host.fyi/catalog.json): every App and Recipe, with ports, images and Links
- [Releases](https://github.com/ajnart/selfhost-skills/releases): CLI archives and checksums.txt

## Commands

- `self-host doctor --json`: check Docker, ports and the machine
- `self-host apps list --json`, `self-host apps info <app> --json`: browse the Catalog
- `self-host install <app|recipe> --yes --json`: install after approval
- `self-host status --json`: Apps, Addresses and Setup state
- `self-host debug <app>`: failed steps, hints and masked logs

## Recipes

- `media` (Media): Watch your movies and shows, and have new ones requested and downloaded for you. Apps: qbittorrent, sonarr, radarr, prowlarr, jellyfin, seerr
- `audio-library` (Audiobooks and music): Listen to your audiobooks and music on your phone or computer. Apps: audiobookshelf, navidrome
- `backups` (Backups and restore): Back up your important files safely, and check you can get them back. Apps: restic
- `dns` (DNS and network filtering): Block ads across your whole home network, with a backup in case one stops. Apps: unbound, adguard-home
- `documents` (Documents, PDF, and OCR): Scan paper into a searchable archive, and edit PDFs without uploading them. Apps: paperless-ngx, stirling-pdf
- `download-privacy` (Downloader privacy): Download torrents through a VPN, and stop if the VPN drops. Apps: gluetun, qbittorrent
- `files` (Files and synchronization): Your own cloud drive, replacing Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox. Apps: nextcloud
- `full` (Full private home server): Everything for a household: movies, photos, files, music, passwords and smart home. Apps: qbittorrent, prowlarr, sonarr, radarr, jellyfin, seerr, immich, nextcloud, navidrome, audiobookshelf, vaultwarden, home-assistant
- `home-automation` (Home automation): Automate your smart home, with cameras that spot people and cars. Apps: home-assistant, node-red, frigate
- `local-ai` (Local AI): Chat with AI on your own computer, so your questions stay private. Apps: ollama, open-webui, beszel
- `monitoring` (Monitoring and observability): Watch your computers and apps and get alerts when something goes wrong. Apps: prometheus, loki, beszel, uptime-kuma, grafana
- `owned-video-library` (Owned movie and TV library): Stream the movies and shows you already own to every screen. Apps: jellyfin
- `passwords` (Passwords): Set up a password manager for the whole household. Apps: vaultwarden
- `personal-finance` (Personal finance): Track your spending and budget privately. Apps: actual-budget
- `personal-media` (Personal media): Watch movies and shows, with downloads, subtitles and requests handled for you. Apps: qbittorrent, gluetun, sonarr, radarr, prowlarr, bazarr, jellyfin, seerr
- `photos` (Photos and mobile backup): Back up your family photos automatically from every phone. Apps: immich
- `photos-and-files` (Photos and cloud files): Back up your photos and keep your files in sync, replacing cloud drives. Apps: immich, nextcloud
- `private-notes` (Private notes and knowledge): A private place for your family or team to write and share notes. Apps: docmost
- `remote-access` (Remote access): Reach your apps from outside your home, privately or through your own web address. Apps: tailscale, cloudflare-tunnel, caddy

## Apps

- `actual-budget` (Actual Budget, Productivity): Plan your spending and follow every dollar, with one budget on all your devices
- `adguard-home` (AdGuard Home, DNS): Block ads and trackers on every device at home, with a simple control page
- `archive-team-warrior` (ArchiveTeam Warrior, Downloads): Lend your spare internet time to help save websites before they disappear
- `aria2` (Aria2, Downloads): Download files and torrents in the background, controlled by other tools
- `audiobookshelf` (Audiobookshelf, Media): Listen to your audiobooks and podcasts on your phone or in a browser
- `authelia` (Authelia, Identity): Add a login page with a second security step in front of your other apps
- `authentik` (Authentik, Identity): Sign in once to reach all your apps, with one login for the whole household
- `bazarr` (Bazarr, Requests): Automatically find subtitles for your movies and shows
- `beszel` (Beszel, Monitoring): See how busy your computers are: processor, memory and disk space
- `bookstack` (BookStack, Productivity): Keep notes and how-to guides organized in books, chapters and pages
- `borgmatic` (Borgmatic, Backups): Back up your files on a schedule, safely encrypted
- `caddy` (Caddy, Ingress): Give your apps their own web addresses, with the secure padlock set up for you
- `cloudflare-tunnel` (Cloudflare Tunnel, Remote access): Open your app to the internet safely through Cloudflare, with no router changes
- `dashdot` (Dash., Monitoring): See kernel-visible processor and memory use
- `deluge` (Deluge, Downloads): Download torrents in the background, with a simple web page to manage them
- `dockge` (Dockge, Containers): Start, stop and edit your apps from a simple web page
- `docmost` (Docmost, Productivity): Write and share notes and documents with your family or team
- `emby` (Emby, Media): Watch your own movies and shows on any TV, phone or computer
- `firefly-iii` (Firefly III, Productivity): Track your income, expenses and budgets in one private place
- `forgejo` (Forgejo, Developer tools): Store and track your software code privately, like a private GitHub
- `freshrss` (FreshRSS, Productivity): Read news from all your favorite websites in one place
- `frigate` (Frigate, Cameras): Record your security cameras and get alerts when people or cars appear
- `gatus` (Gatus, Monitoring): Check that your apps are working and see them on a status page
- `glances` (Glances, Monitoring): See the workload visible to Glances without extra access to your computer
- `gluetun` (Gluetun, Downloads): Send your downloads through a VPN, and stop them if it disconnects
- `gotify` (Gotify, Communication): Collect notifications from your apps and send them to your phone
- `grafana` (Grafana, Observability): Turn numbers about your computers and apps into charts and alerts
- `haproxy` (HAProxy, Ingress): Give your apps one shared front door, with a page of usage statistics
- `headscale` (Headscale, Remote access): Connect your devices into one private network, without a Tailscale account
- `homarr` (Homarr, Dashboard): Put all your apps on one home page, each a click away.
